description: This file defines the LinkRenderer class used for rendering Markdown links within the Daux documentation generator, with custom URL resolution and link attribute handling.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: Custom Markdown link renderer implementing URL resolution and link attribute modifications for Daux documentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LinkRenderer with Daux configuration and sets up the parent link renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a Markdown link node, resolving URLs, setting attributes, and handling external and broken links.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for the renderer by delegating to the parent renderer.
